The '''Khadaji Singularity''' was one of the more active [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]] known in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], during the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the last stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it consumed a shipment of gemstones from the [[Jalorian Sodality]].
